title: Monique M Probable FDE 9402 NDE 9402
content: I was on a family vacation in San Diego when I was 11. We were using “boogie boards” to play around in the ocean. I went out on the beach by myself. This part is fuzzy, but I think a wave knocked me over and I was pinned under my board and I remember it feeling very heavy. I couldn’t move it and I felt panicked for a second. Then I felt peaceful. Everything was black and I got a sudden rush of all the memories in my life in a warm amber hue tone. Almost like I was watching it but not watching it - it just was in my mind but it was clear. I felt like going to sleep. Somehow (I’m still not sure, or maybe just don’t remember due to the trauma) I was released from the board and started coughing up water immediately. boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Released from under the board and started coughing up water immediately.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pinned under a boogie board in the ocean; possible drowning.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Blackness followed by a rapid flash of life memories in a warm amber hue; then return to coughing up water.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel; blackness and memory-flash/life review occurred, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience characterized primarily by blackness and a rapid sequence of life memories in a warm amber hue; no beings, no tunnel, and experiencer interprets it as 'just memories.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Everything was black and I got a sudden rush of all the memories in my life in a warm amber hue tone.”
